simple.meaning: כֶּסֶף (keçeph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “silver (from its pale color); by implication, money.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 403 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 13:2. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, covenant.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֶּסֶף (H3701).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: כֶּסֶף (keçeph) / H3701 is traced through Genesis 13:2, Genesis 17:12, Genesis 17:13, Genesis 17:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.

But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
